FabricationProcess.Technology: N5 for the accelerator complex dies (XCDs); the four I/O dies (IODs) are built on N6 and the package uses 3.5D die stacking with hybrid bonding on a CoWoS interposer

Chip.Description: Primary subject of this description is the AMD Instinct MI300X discrete GPU (OAM module): 8 XCDs stacked over 4 IODs with 8 HBM3 stacks, 304 active compute units, 1216 Matrix Cores, 19,456 stream processors, 2100 MHz peak engine clock, 750 W maximum TBP, and roughly 153 billion transistors. The MI300A APU shares the same gfx942 ISA but substitutes 3 'Zen 4' CCDs (24 x86 cores) for 2 of the XCDs, leaving 6 XCDs / 228 active CUs / 912 Matrix Cores / 14,592 stream processors, 128 GB of HBM3 unified coherently with the CPU, and a 550 W TDP (760 W in liquid-cooled configurations). Both parts expose 256 MB of AMD Infinity Cache and 5.3 TB/s of peak HBM3 bandwidth

XCD (Accelerator Complex Die).Description: Accelerator complex die on TSMC N5. Each XCD physically contains 40 CUs of which 38 are active (2 disabled for yield), grouped under 4 Asynchronous Compute Engines and a hardware scheduler, all sharing one 4 MB L2 cache. MI300X uses 8 XCDs (304 CUs); MI300A uses 6 (228 CUs). XCDs are the unit of spatial partitioning: MI300X supports SPX/DPX/QPX/CPX modes down to one partition per XCD, MI300A supports up to 3 partitions of 2 XCDs

Compute Unit.Description: CDNA 3 compute unit: instruction fetch and scheduling, a scalar unit, 4 SIMD units totalling 64 stream processors, 4 Matrix Cores, load/store pipelines, 64 KB of Local Data Share and a 32 KB L1 vector data cache. Executes wave64 wavefronts; up to 16 wavefronts (1024 work-items) per work-group

SIMD Unit.Description: 16-lane vector ALU; a 64 work-item wavefront is issued across 4 cycles. CDNA 3 doubles vector FP32 throughput over CDNA 2 with packed FP32 operations (packed-fp32-ops), reaching 256 FLOPs/clock/CU for vector FP32 and 128 FLOPs/clock/CU for vector FP64

Matrix Core.Description: Matrix multiply-accumulate unit driven by the MFMA/SMFMAC instruction families. Per CU per clock: 256 FLOPs matrix FP64, 256 matrix FP32, 1024 TF32 (XF32), 2048 FP16, 2048 BF16, 4096 FP8 (E4M3 and E5M2), 4096 INT8. Structured sparsity (at least 2 zeros in every group of 4 values) doubles matrix INT8/FP8/FP16/BF16 throughput to 8192 operations per clock per CU

Asynchronous Compute Engine (ACE).Description: Compute accelerator that dispatches compute-shader workgroups to the CUs of its XCD; each ACE is associated with 10 of the 40 physical CUs and drives 8 hardware queues

Hardware Scheduler (HWS).Description: Per-XCD global resource that schedules work across the four ACEs and their hardware queues

IOD (I/O Die).Description: Active I/O die on TSMC N6, vertically stacked beneath a pair of XCDs. Hosts the AMD Infinity Cache slices, the HBM3 memory controllers for 2 stacks, the AMD Infinity Fabric network, and the media engines

Infinity Fabric Link.Description: Two 16-lane bidirectional inter-package AMD Infinity Fabric links per IOD (8 per package), signalling at up to 32 Gbps for 128 GB/s bidirectional each. One link per IOD is multi-purpose and can instead be configured as x16 PCIe Gen 5. MI300X uses seven as scale-up Infinity Fabric links (896 GB/s aggregate, fully connecting 8 GPUs on an OCP UBB 2.0 board) plus one x16 PCIe Gen 5 host link; MI300A dedicates 4 to Infinity Fabric and leaves 4 assignable to Infinity Fabric or PCIe Gen 5

HBM3 Memory Controller.Description: Each IOD fans out through the package to 2 HBM3 stacks; the controllers drive the bus at 5.2 Gbps

Video Decoder.Description: Decode-only media engine for HEVC/H.265, AVC/H.264, VP9 or AV1. MI300X has 4 such decoder groups, MI300A has 3. No video encoders are present on CDNA 3

JPEG/MJPEG Codec Core.Description: 8 JPEG/MJPEG codec cores accompany each decoder group, for 32 cores on MI300X and 24 on MI300A

HBM3 Stack.Description: 8 HBM3 stacks per package, 24 GB each on MI300X (192 GB total) and 16 GB each on MI300A (128 GB total). Each stack is associated with 16 Infinity Cache channels

VGPR.description: A wavefront may allocate up to 512 VGPRs, split flexibly between at most 256 architectural VGPRs and at most 256 accumulation VGPRs (AGPRs) used by the matrix VALU instructions; 64-bit operands and AGPR tuples require even alignment (LLVM vgpr-align2). 512 registers x 64 lanes x 4 bytes gives the 128 KB per-SIMD figure recorded here (512 KB per CU); AMD did not publish a change to the physical register file capacity between CDNA 2 and CDNA 3

SGPR.description: A wavefront is allocated 16 to 102 SGPRs in units of 16 dwords, with VCC stored in the top two and 16 further SGPRs reserved when a trap handler is present. AMD does not publish the physical SGPR file capacity for CDNA 3, so no size is recorded

LDS.description: 64 KB of software-managed Local Data Share (LDS) on-chip memory per compute unit, organized as 32 banks of 512 dwords with 32 integer atomic units. Shared by the work-items of a work-group; a work-group may request the full 64 KB. Reads across a wavefront are dispatched over four cycles. Unchanged from CDNA 2

L1 Vector Cache.description: Per-CU L1 vector data cache. CDNA 3 doubles the line size to 128 B and the capacity to 32 KB versus CDNA 2, and widens both the request bus to the core and the fill path from L2 to match, doubling bandwidth to the core. Relaxed coherency model requiring explicit synchronization

Instruction Cache.description: 64 KB 8-way set-associative instruction cache shared between two compute units, doubling both capacity and associativity versus CDNA 2

L2.description: 4 MB 16-way set-associative writeback, write-allocate cache shared by the 38 active CUs of an XCD, built from 16 channels of 256 KB. Each channel reads out a 128 B line and the cache sustains four requests from different CUs per cycle for 2 KB/clock per XCD; writes are half-line (64 B) per channel. Lowest level at which coherency is maintained in hardware. The recorded bandwidth is the whitepaper's 34.4 TB/s aggregate read bandwidth across all 8 XCD L2 instances (its memory-hierarchy figure legend instead labels the L2-to-XCD path 51.6 TB/s)

Infinity Cache.description: 256 MB 16-way set-associative memory-side last level cache (MALL) per package, distributed across the 4 IODs: 16 channels per HBM3 stack, 128 channels total, each 64 B wide and backed by 2 MB of banked data array, for 17.2 TB/s peak bandwidth. Being memory-side it holds no dirty data evicted from lower levels, does not participate in coherency or absorb snoop traffic, and can cache nominally uncacheable memory; it does contain a snoop filter covering the XCD L2 caches. On MI300A it is shared between the XCDs and the 'Zen 4' CPU dies

HBM3.description: 192 GB of HBM3 on MI300X across 8 stacks of 24 GB, on an 8192-bit interface clocked at 5.2 Gbps for 5.3 TB/s peak theoretical bandwidth. MI300A carries 128 GB (8 stacks of 16 GB) at the same 5.3 TB/s, unified and cache-coherent between the CPU and GPU dies in a single physical and virtual address space. Full-chip ECC with page retirement and page avoidance

LLVMFeatures.Name: gfx9-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Additional instructions for GFX9+; gfx942 is ISA version 9.4.2 in the GCN GFX9 encoding family

LLVMFeatures.Name: gfx90a-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Additional instructions introduced with GFX90A (CDNA 2)

LLVMFeatures.Name: gfx940-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Additional instructions for GFX940+ (CDNA 3)

LLVMFeatures.Name: mai-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Matrix Arithmetic Instructions: the V_MFMA family executed on the Matrix Cores

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp8-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp8 (E4M3) and bf8 (E5M2) instructions, including the FP8 MFMA variants

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp8-conversion-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp8 and bf8 conversion instructions such as v_cvt_f32_fp8 and v_cvt_f32_bf8

LLVMFeatures.Name: cvt-fp8-sdwa-src-sel
LLVMFeatures.Description: FP8/BF8 conversions take the byte index from the SDWA src0_sel or op_sel field

LLVMFeatures.Name: xf32-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_mfma_f32_16x16x8_xf32 and v_mfma_f32_32x32x4_xf32, the TF32 (XF32) matrix instructions new in CDNA 3

LLVMFeatures.Name: packed-fp32-ops
LLVMFeatures.Description: Support packed fp32 instructions (v_pk_fma_f32, v_pk_mul_f32, v_pk_add_f32), which double vector FP32 throughput per CU versus CDNA 2

LLVMFeatures.Name: full-rate-64-ops
LLVMFeatures.Description: Most fp64 instructions are full rate

LLVMFeatures.Name: fmacf64-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_fmac_f64 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: pk-fmac-f16-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_pk_fmac_f16 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: fma-mix-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_fma_mix_f32, v_fma_mixlo_f16 and v_fma_mixhi_f16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dl-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_fmac_f32 and v_xnor_b32 deep-learning instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot1-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot4_i32_i8 and v_dot8_i32_i4 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot2-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2_i32_i16 and v_dot2_u32_u16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot3-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot8c_i32_i4 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot4-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2c_i32_i16 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot5-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2c_f32_f16 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot6-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot4c_i32_i8 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot7-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot4_u32_u8 and v_dot8_u32_u4 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot10-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2_f32_f16 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dpp-64bit
LLVMFeatures.Description: Support DPP (Data Parallel Primitives) extension in the double-precision ALU

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-fadd-rtn-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has buffer/global/flat floating-point atomic add instructions that return the original value

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-fadd-no-rtn-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has floating-point atomic add instructions that do not return the original value

LLVMFeatures.Name: flat-atomic-fadd-f32-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has flat_atomic_add_f32 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: flat-buffer-global-fadd-f64-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has flat, buffer and global instructions for f64 atomic fadd

LLVMFeatures.Name: memory-atomic-fadd-f32-denormal-support
LLVMFeatures.Description: global/flat/buffer atomic fadd for float supports denormal handling

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-ds-pk-add-16-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has ds_pk_add_f16 and ds_pk_add_rtn_f16 packed LDS atomic add instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-flat-pk-add-16-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has flat_atomic_pk_add_f16 and flat_atomic_pk_add_bf16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-buffer-global-pk-add-f16-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has buffer and global packed f16 atomic add instructions that can return the original value

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-global-pk-add-bf16-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has global_atomic_pk_add_bf16 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: lds-atomic-add-f64
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has ds_add_f64 and ds_add_rtn_f64 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: atomic-fmin-fmax-global-f64
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has global/buffer instructions for atomicrmw fmin/fmax on double-precision floats

LLVMFeatures.Name: agent-scope-fine-grained-remote-memory-atomics
LLVMFeatures.Description: Agent-scope fine-grained atomics work on remote (non-local) device memory

LLVMFeatures.Name: v-mov-b64-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_mov_b64 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: lshl-add-u64-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_lshl_add_u64 instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: vgpr-align2
LLVMFeatures.Description: VGPR and AGPR tuple operands require even alignment

LLVMFeatures.Name: architected-flat-scratch
LLVMFeatures.Description: Flat Scratch register is a read-only SPI-initialized architected register

LLVMFeatures.Name: packed-tid
LLVMFeatures.Description: Work-item IDs are packed into v0 at kernel launch

LLVMFeatures.Name: kernarg-preload
LLVMFeatures.Description: Hardware supports preloading of kernel arguments into user SGPRs

LLVMFeatures.Name: back-off-barrier
LLVMFeatures.Description: Hardware supports backing off s_barrier if an exception occurs

LLVMFeatures.Name: tgsplit-support
LLVMFeatures.Description: Hardware support for threadgroup split execution mode, letting a work-group's wavefronts run on different CUs

LLVMFeatures.Name: xnack
LLVMFeatures.Description: Enable XNACK support (memory page-fault replay). Part of the gfx942 target ID as xnack- / xnack+

LLVMFeatures.Name: sramecc
LLVMFeatures.Description: Enable SRAM ECC. Part of the gfx942 target ID as sramecc- / sramecc+

LLVMFeatures.Name: wavefrontsize64
LLVMFeatures.Description: Wavefronts are 64 work-items wide; gfx942 is wave64 only

PowerStates.Name: Active
PowerStates.Description: Full power state with all 8 XCDs, the Infinity Cache and all 8 HBM3 stacks active, up to the 750 W maximum TBP of the MI300X OAM module. MI300A is rated 550 W for air and liquid cooling and 760 W for liquid cooling only. AMD publishes only the 2100 MHz peak engine clock, not a base clock, so no BaseClock is recorded

PowerStates.Name: Idle
PowerStates.Description: Reduced power state when no workloads are running
